name: riplexa-timestamps
description: Real timestamps inline, right inside the conversation, in the Claude Code and Codex chat panels — on every message you send, every reply, and every tool call (start→end). Not a side panel. On/Off and colors change live.

commands.title: Riplexa Timestamps: Remove from chat panels (restore original files)

riplexaTimestamps.enabled.markdownDescription: Show real timestamps in the Claude Code and Codex chat panels. Changes apply live, without a reload.

riplexaTimestamps.diagnostics.markdownDescription: Show a small diagnostics box in the Codex panel: what the extension found (messages, commands, items) and where it placed each time. Use it when a panel shows no times, and include a screenshot in a bug report. Live.

riplexaTimestamps.showStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show the **Timestamp: On/Off** toggle in the status bar.

riplexaTimestamps.userMessageColor.markdownDescription: Text color of **your own messages** in the Claude Code and Codex chat panels, as a CSS color — e.g. `#90EE90`, `lightgreen`, `rgb(144,238,144)`. Leave empty to keep the panel's own color. Changes apply live.
